text:
As of 2017, about 82% of Americans lived in urban areas under the Census Bureau's definition, which doesn't match either 92% or 72% exactly. Given the two options, 72% is the closer fit only if a narrower urban definition is used, but the standard figure is roughly 80–82%. I'd note the commonly cited Census figure remains near 80–82%, not 92%.

CONFIDENCE: 70
